Changelog

Changes since the version sent to Open Minds. The version is shown in the bottom-right corner of the board.

1.2 — 2026-10-21

  • Version label in the bottom-right corner of the board.

1.1 — 2026-10-21

  • Sentence generator: irregular plurals without -s (fish, snowmen) are no longer put in the plural, so the generator never shows «fish + s». They still appear as singular subjects. Why not generate «the fish run» instead (no s on the noun nor on the verb): on the board it would look like an agreement mistake — a noun that seems singular with a verb without -s. Without the teacher explaining it, a first-year pupil would read it as an error. The teacher can still show the invariable plural by hand: the board reads it as «fish».
  • Sentence generator, level 6: with let's the place now goes after the verb («let's hop in the garden» instead of «in the garden let's hop»).

1.0 — 2026-10-13 (sent to Open Minds on 2026-10-17)
